inline.blurb: <sp>Single platform</sp> is one platform or a two-platform pair (e.g. OnlyFans + ManyVids) with band-specific list prices. <bu>Bundled</bu> is OnlyFans + Fansly in one bill for that band. <pr>Protection & Anti-Piracy</pr> is a separate {protectionPrice}/mo add-on for Clips4Sale, ManyVids, Loyalfans, Fanvue, MYM, and other non-API coverage (stackable with a main plan). List bundles like OnlyFans + Fansly use fixed band prices, not a simple +{bundleAddon}/mo on the OnlyFans line — use the <calc>Pricing</calc> calculator for exact numbers.

faq.heading: Questions
faq.bundleAnswer: Single platform = one platform or a two-platform pair with band-specific list prices. Bundled = OnlyFans + Fansly together. Non-API coverage (ManyVids, Clips4Sale, etc.) uses the separate {protectionPrice}/mo Protection plan.
faq.bundleQuestionJsonLd: Single platform vs Bundled vs Protection?
faq.bundleAnswerJsonLd: Single platform = one adult platform or a two-platform pair. Bundled = OnlyFans + Fansly together. Protection = {protectionPrice}/mo for anti-piracy on Clips4Sale, ManyVids, Loyalfans, Fanvue, MYM, and similar; stackable with a main plan or standalone.
faq.creditsAnswer: Paid plans include 20% of your subscription as credits each month ($1 = 100 credits). Trial: {trialCredits} credits total.
faq.trialAnswerPage: See current trial terms when you sign up. Upgrade or cancel anytime in Settings → Billing.
faq.trialBillingHint: Upgrade or cancel anytime in Settings → Billing.
faq.changeAnswerJsonLd: Yes. Swap platforms, single-platform vs Bundled, or band in Settings → Billing.
faq.changeAnswerPagePro: Yes. Swap platforms, single-platform vs Bundled, Protection, or band in Settings → Billing.

page.pickBand: Pick your band. Pick your platforms. That’s it.
